--- a/README.md
+++ b/README.md
@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+# Smart Environment Monitoring and Control
+
+ESP32 Arduino firmware with DHT22, MQ-135, LDR and PIR inputs, relay control,
+an SSD1306 display, HTTP dashboard, WebSocket updates, NVS settings and optional SD logging.
+
+## Build
+
+Install PlatformIO Core, then run from this directory:
+
+```sh
+pio run -e esp32dev
+```
+
+The ESP32 platform and external libraries are pinned in `platformio.ini`.
+Preferences, WiFi, Wire, SPI, FS and SD come from the Arduino-ESP32 framework.
+WebSocket code uses `links2004/WebSockets`, which provides `WebSocketsServer.h`.
+
+In ForgeX, enable **I trust this project for local builds and tests** for this
+project, then use **Verify locally** on a saved draft. Build trust is scoped to
+the project and its directory. Firmware upload is a separate action.
+
+Build output is `.pio/build/esp32dev/firmware.bin`. Use the complete upload
+manifest when flashing a new board; the application binary alone is not a
+complete first-install image. Serial monitoring uses 115200 baud.
+
+## Hardware and dashboard
+
+See [hardware_mapping.md](docs/hardware_mapping.md) for the pins used by the source.
+The dashboard runs at `http://<device-IP>/`; WebSocket updates use port 81.
+After a 30-second station connection timeout the firmware starts the
+`EnvMonitor_Setup` access point. Check the serial console for its IP address.
+The generated access-point password is `setup1234`; change it before deployment.
+
+HTTP commands use form-encoded POST bodies:
+
+- `/api/mode`: `mode=auto` or `mode=manual`.
+- `/api/relay`: `fan=on`, `fan=off`, `light=on` or `light=off`.
+- `/api/settings`: `temp_threshold`, `hysteresis` and `air_quality_threshold`.
+
+Read endpoints are `/api/sensors`, `/api/status` and `/api/logs`.
+
+## Verification scope
+
+The repair is verified with the real ESP32 compiler. Hardware behavior has
+not been verified and no board has been flashed. Confirm sensor readings,
+relay polarity, display operation, HTTP controls, settings persistence and
+SD writes on the actual board before relying on them.
+
+This saved draft uses the Arduino loop and asynchronous networking; it does
+not implement a separate FreeRTOS task architecture. WiFi credentials can be
+stored by the firmware, but an HTTP provisioning form is not implemented.
+Buzzer output, physical buttons and status LEDs remain placeholders.
+The MQ-135 conversion is an uncalibrated approximation, not a validated PPM
+measurement. Compilation does not verify these unfinished requirements.

--- a/docs/hardware_mapping.md
+++ b/docs/hardware_mapping.md
@@ -0,0 +1,32 @@
+# Hardware mapping used by this firmware
+
+These assignments come from the generated source and are preserved by the repair.
+
+| Component | ESP32 GPIO | Source |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| DHT22 data | 4 | `src/sensors/temperature_sensor.cpp` |
+| MQ-135 analog input | 34 | `src/sensors/air_quality_sensor.h` |
+| LDR analog input | 35 | `src/sensors/light_sensor.h` |
+| PIR input | 32 | `src/sensors/motion_sensor.h` |
+| Fan relay | 26 | `src/control/relay_controller.h` |
+| Light relay | 27 | `src/control/relay_controller.h` |
+| SSD1306 SDA | 21 | Default ESP32 `Wire.begin()` |
+| SSD1306 SCL | 22 | Default ESP32 `Wire.begin()` |
+| SD chip select | 5 | `src/storage/data_logger.h` |
+| SD clock | 18 | Default ESP32 SPI bus |
+| SD MISO | 19 | Default ESP32 SPI bus |
+| SD MOSI | 23 | Default ESP32 SPI bus |
+
+The display uses I2C address `0x3C` and a 128 by 64 screen. Relay controls are
+active LOW. Buzzer state is currently logged in software; no buzzer output
+pin is driven. Physical buttons and status LEDs are not implemented. The
+watchdog's GPIO4 declaration is unused; external watchdog output is disabled.
+
+The original draft's GPIO13/14 analog, GPIO15 PIR and reversed OLED SDA/SCL
+documentation did not match its source. Follow the table above. Do not share
+SD GPIO18/19/23 with the draft's proposed LEDs, buzzer or button wiring.
+
+Verify each module's supply voltage and output level against its datasheet
+before connecting it. ESP32 inputs must stay within their electrical limits;
+an MQ module powered at 5 V can require conditioning of its analog output.
+Sensor calibration and the assembled circuit have not been verified by a build.

--- a/platformio.ini
+++ b/platformio.ini
@@ -0,0 +1,44 @@
+; PlatformIO Configuration for Smart Environment Monitoring System
+; 
+; Build options: upload flags, source filters, etc.
+[env:esp32dev]
+platform = espressif32@7.1.3
+board = esp32dev
+framework = arduino
+monitor_speed = 115200
+
+; Build flags
+build_flags =
+    -std=gnu++17
+    -Wall
+    -Wextra
+build_unflags = -std=gnu++11
+
+; Library dependencies
+lib_deps = 
+    adafruit/Adafruit SSD1306@2.5.17
+    adafruit/Adafruit GFX Library@1.12.6
+    adafruit/Adafruit Unified Sensor@1.1.15
+    adafruit/DHT sensor library@1.4.7
+    esp32async/AsyncTCP@3.5.0
+    esp32async/ESPAsyncWebServer@3.12.1
+    links2004/WebSockets@2.7.3
+    bblanchon/ArduinoJson@7.4.3
+
+; Upload options
+upload_port = 
+upload_speed = 921600
+
+; Monitor options
+monitor_filters = 
+    timeval
+    default
+    direct
+
+; Custom options for OTA (commented out for basic build)
+; upload_protocol = espota
+; upload_port = 192.168.1.100
+
+; Optional: Enable serial debugging
+; build_flags += 
+;     -DCORE_DEBUG_LEVEL=ESP_LOG_VERBOSE
